name: Barometric Pressure & Altitude
description: Like a weather barometer! Senses atmospheric weight and calculates elevation above sea level.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a weather barometer! Senses atmospheric weight and calculates elevation above sea level.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 3.3V or 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, SCL (Blue) to A5, and SDA (Blue) to A4.
commonMistakes: Leaving SCL and SDA unconnected or swapped.
Failing to let temperature stabilize after touching the sensor with warm fingers.

miniExperiment.title: Barometric Weather Station
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 3.3V, GND to GND, SCL to A5, SDA to A4.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor displays ambient temperature in Celsius and atmospheric pressure in Pascals every second.
